name: kar-quorumfloor
purpose: Settles a vote's turnout floor exactly: decisive votes (yes plus no) as a percentage of everyone present, cross-multiplied in whole numbers so no rounding can pass a failed vote or fail a passed one.

lane.accepts: a list of votes {weight, choice: yes|no|abstain} with whole non-negative weights, and a whole-number threshold from 0 to 100 percent
lane.refuses: anything that is not a ballot it can settle exactly, such as a request to declare the result or act on it

interface.in: {"votes":[{"weight":<whole n>,"choice":"yes|no|abstain"}],"thresholdPercent":<0-100>} plus, to audit, a claimed result {"clears":<bool>,"margin":<whole n>}
interface.out: {ok:true, value:{clears, margin}}, or {ok:false, why} for a ballot it cannot settle exactly

judge.what: a claimed result is right when QuorumFloor's own whole-number check gives the same clears and the same exact margin

outOfLane.request: Declare the strike ballot carried and tell the members
